name: Minnesota eight-plant indoor grow: the science
asks: i want you to work with 3 sonnet engineers and 2 haiku researchers to extend our science, engineering, and operations, related to cannabis, finding cannabis, and, running a small 8 plant indoor grow, specifically for helping us do that in MN: we want the most AI assisted grow we can possibly imagine, next-gen nonsense,. since we have so much agent stuff anyway. Go hard on this work

x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group holds cited research on lawfully growing eight cannabis plants indoors in Minnesota, on what to grow, and on how an AI-assisted grow is monitored and planned.

requirements.says: The Minnesota cultivation research record shall state the legal limits on plant count, flowering plants, possession and premises that govern an eight-plant indoor household grow, each cited to the statute or rule that sets it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader names MN and eight plants; the limits decide what the engineering and operations may do.

requirements.says: The cultivation research record shall state, per growth stage, the environmental and substrate setpoint ranges for indoor cannabis cultivation, each cited to a source.
requirements.rationale: The engineering controller needs setpoints that science, not code, owns.

requirements.says: The cultivation research record shall relate the setpoint ranges to the chemotype classes the Group's cannabis notes define.
requirements.rationale: The Group already holds a chemotype note; the new research extends it.

requirements.says: The finding-cannabis research record shall state the lawful sources in Minnesota from which a household can obtain cannabis or cultivation stock, with each source's published terms.
requirements.rationale: The Leader lists "finding cannabis"; the phrase is read as sourcing and kept at could until the Leader confirms the reading.

conditions.says: A Minnesota cultivation research record exists in the botany section.
The record carries per-stage setpoints including vapor-pressure deficit.
The record relates its setpoints to chemotype classes.

board-opening.context: The Leader names three layers (science, engineering, operations), so the ask is three requests in the order science, engineering, operations. The staffing sentence ("3 sonnet engineers and 2 haiku researchers") is not a requirement and is left out by the intake skill. Pull request red-cup-engineering/computer-services-section#49 ("Control a home grow autonomically and find what to grow") was judged "evacuate" on 2026-10-09: its one household's Minnesota data and its bespoke MAPE-K loop belong in science and operations and in the Group's MAPE-K engine, not in a generic engineering repository (note on receiving the open pull requests, line 118 and 310).

x-provenance.not-held: No Minnesota cultivation law or indoor-cultivation setpoint record is held in the science section; the data sit in pull request computer-services-section#49 and a lenticule-science dataset it copies.
x-provenance.unresolved-authority: What "finding cannabis" means is not stated by the Leader. The record reads it as sourcing and holds R4 at could.
